name: Young Hearts
source: The protagonist of the story is Maks, a young guy who has just graduated from high school and is going to university. For his purposes, he has chosen a rather prestigious institution located in a completely different city, where his good friend Alex, with whom he has been communicating on the Internet for a long time, also resides. Almost immediately upon arrival, the main character finds himself in Alex's company, which consists of not exactly mediocre guys - novice and already experienced musicians, writers, artists. Curious and easy on the rise, Maks together with his new buddies is looking for answers to their questions to life, and at the same time to his own question: "Who is really an observer among the creators - the deprived talent or the cornerstone of all creativity?"
